title: Need Help with GIMP for sprites

posts.author: RyanJimenez
posts.body: Hello everybody! This is my first post on this forum, and thanks for seeing it! So I have a project in RPG Maker XP that I am developing and I got GIMP to check the grid of the sprites, but for some reason the grid wont work when I put in 32 x 48. This is driving me crazy and I want to finish these sprites so I can develop the game! I won't give up though, and I will keep going! So here is the picture:
